7.8.2.4 Transmission Retry Handling
[SWS_IdsM_01503] Retry Handling
Upstream requirements: RS_Ids_00630
⌈If the transmission request over PduR_IdsMTransmit is declined, i.e., the API does
not return E_OK, IdsM shall wait a time period of IdsMTransmissionRetryDelay
and attempt to transmit the same message again.⌋
Note: The retry mechanism applied for IF and TP Pdus.
